description: This Java source file defines a Spring Data configuration class that sets up data source, entity manager factory, transaction management, and database initialization for an application using embedded HSQL database.

classes.name: DataConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up data source, JPA entity manager, transaction management, and database initialization.

methods.name: expressionEvaluationContextProvider
methods.description: Provides a SecurityEvaluationContextExtension bean for security expression evaluation.

methods.name: dataSource
methods.description: Creates and returns an embedded HSQL database DataSource.

methods.name: entityManagerFactory
methods.description: Configures and returns a LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean with Hibernate JPA vendor and package scanning.

methods.name: initDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database with SQL script 'data.sql' after the entity manager factory is initialized.

methods.name: transactionManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a JPA transaction manager linked to the entity manager factory.
